40010865.author: पदार्थः
40010865.content: अथ then, परिश्रान्तः an exhausted person, महाप्राज्ञः very wise, अङ्गदः Angada, तदा then, सर्वान् all, वानरान् the vanaras, समाश्वास्य consoled, शनैः slowly, इदम् these, वचः words, अब्रवीत् said.

40010865.author: Translation
40010865.content: Wise Angada, exhausted after the search, collected the monkeys, and consoling them, said slowly:

40010866.author: पदार्थः
40010866.content: अस्माभिः by all of us, सह along with, वनानि forests, गिरयः the mountains, नद्यः the rivers, दुर्गाणि inaccessible forts, गहनानि च dense, दर्यः caves, गिरिगुहाश्चैव and the mountain ranges also, समन्ततः all over, तत्र तत्र everywhere, विचितानि searched, जानकी Janaki, न दृश्यते is not seen, तदा then, सीता Sita, हृता येन by one who has stolen, सुरसुतोपमा one who is like a goddess, रक्षः च raksha, वा or.

40010866.author: Translation
40010866.content: 'We have searched here, there, everywhere, in dense forests, hills, forts, impenetrable caverns and mountain ranges. But we could find neither Janaki who is like a goddess nor the demon who abducted her.

40010867.author: पदार्थः
40010867.content: अस्माभिः by all of us, सह along with, वनानि forests, गिरयः the mountains, नद्यः the rivers, दुर्गाणि inaccessible forts, गहनानि च dense, दर्यः caves, गिरिगुहाश्चैव and the mountain ranges also, समन्ततः all over, तत्र तत्र everywhere, विचितानि searched, जानकी Janaki, न दृश्यते is not seen, तदा then, सीता Sita, हृता येन by one who has stolen, सुरसुतोपमा one who is like a goddess, रक्षः च raksha, वा or.

40010867.author: Translation
40010867.content: 'We have searched here, there, everywhere, in dense forests, hills, forts, impenetrable caverns and mountain ranges. But we could find neither Janaki who is like a goddess nor the demon who abducted her.

40010868.author: पदार्थः
40010868.content: नः for us, महान् long, कालः time, यातः over, सुग्रीवश्च Sugriva also, उग्रशासनः  strict in administration, तस्मात् therefore, भवन्तः all of you, सहिताः together, समन्ततः all over, विचिन्वन्तु you may search for.

40010868.author: Translation
40010868.content: Much time has elapsed for us and Sugriva is strict in his rule; therefore let all of you together search everywhere.

40010869.author: पदार्थः
40010869.content: समुत्थिताम् overpowering us, तन्द्रीं laziness, शोकं च and sorrow, निद्रां चैव even sleep, विहाय after giving up, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, सीताम् Sita, पश्यामः we will see, यथा so also, विचिनुध्वम् you may search.

40010869.author: Translation
40010869.content: 'You should keep searching on till we see Sita, Janaka's daughter, giving up laziness and sorrow and sleep that is overpowering us.

40010870.author: पदार्थः
40010870.content: अनिर्वेदम् zeal, दाक्ष्यं च capability and, मनसः mind's, अपराजयं च robust optimism, कार्यसिद्धिकराणि conducive  to success, आहुः is said, तस्मात् therefore, अहम् I am, एतत् all this, ब्रवीमि I am telling you.

40010870.author: Translation
40010870.content: 'It is said, zeal, capability, and fortitude can overcome defeat and lead to success. Therefore I am saying this.

40010871.author: पदार्थः
40010871.content: अद्यापि even now, वनौकसः you forestdwellers, दुर्गम् difficult to enter, तत् वनम् that forest, विचिन्वन्तु search, सर्वैः by all, खेदम् grief, त्यक्ता giving up, पुनः again, वनमेव forest itself, विचीयताम् search.

40010871.author: Translation
40010871.content: 'Search this impenetrable forest even now, O you denizens of this forest Give up grief, let us all once again ransack this forest.

40010872.author: पदार्थः
40010872.content: क्रियमाणस्य being carried on, कर्मणः of the deed, फलम् result, अवश्यम् certainly, दृश्यते will be seen, अलम् enough, निर्वेदम् despair, आगम्य experiencing, नः for us, मीलनम् closing eyes, न क्षमम् हि not proper.

40010872.author: Translation
40010872.content: The fruit of a deed duly performed is surely seen; enough of yielding to despair—for us to close our eyes idly is not proper.

40010873.author: पदार्थः
40010873.content: वानरः monkey, राजा king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, कोपनः an angry one, तीक्ष्णदण्डश्च severe punishment, तस्य his, महात्मनः of the great self, रामस्य च of Rama also, सततम् ever, भेतव्यम् we have to fear.

40010873.author: Translation
40010873.content: 'Sugriva, the monkey king, is wrathful and awards severe punishment. We should ever bear in mind the (purpose of the) great self, Rama.

40010874.author: पदार्थः
40010874.content: वानराः O monkeys, वः हितार्थम् for your benefit, एतत् all this, उक्तम् said, रोचते यदि if it pleases you, क्रियताम् it may be done, यत् whatever, सर्वेषामेव for all of you, क्षमम् right, नः for us, उच्यताम् you may tell.

40010874.author: Translation
40010874.content: 'I have said all this for your good. You may carry it out, if it pleases you. Speak freely if there is any other course left for all of us, O monkeys'

40010875.author: पदार्थः
40010875.content: अङ्गदस्य Angada's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पिपासाश्रमखिन्नया worn out by thirst and exhaustion, अव्यक्तया feebly, वाचा with language, वचनम् these words, उवाच expressed.

40010875.author: Translation
40010875.content: Having heard Angada, Gandhamadana worn out by thirst and exhaustion, replied in a feeble tone:

40010876.author: पदार्थः
40010876.content: अङ्गदः Angada, यत् वाक्यम् those words, उवाच ह expressed, वः for us, सदृशं खलु appropriate too, हितं चैव good also, अनुकूलं च even favourable, अस्य his, भाषितम्  utterance, क्रियताम् carry out.

40010876.author: Translation
40010876.content: 'What Angada says is appropriate, beneficial and also favourable. Carry out his command.

40010877.author: पदार्थः
40010877.content: पुनः once again, शैलान् mountains, कन्दरांश्च valleys also, तथा similarly, दरीः caverns, शून्यानि desolate places, काननानि च and forests, गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च mountain streams, मार्गामहै we will explore again.

40010877.author: Translation
40010877.content: 'Once again let us explore the mountains, caverns, forests, desolate places and mountain streams.

40010878.author: पदार्थः
40010878.content: सर्वे all of you, सर्वशः everywhere, महात्मना by great self, सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, यथोद्दिष्टानि as pointed out, सर्वाणि all places, गिरिदुर्गाणि mountains, विचिन्वन्तु search, वनम् forest.

40010878.author: Translation
40010878.content: Let all of you search the forest and the mountain fastnesses everywhere, in all the places pointed out by the great Sugriva.

40010879.author: पदार्थः
40010879.content: ततः then, महाबलाः mighty, ते वानराः those monkeys, पुनः again, समुत्थाय after getting up, विन्ध्यकाननसङ्कीर्णाम् filled with forests surrounding the ranges of Vindhya, दक्षिणां दिशम् in the southern side, विचेरुः started exploring.

40010879.author: Translation
40010879.content: Once again the  monkeys rose up and started exploring the mountain ranges of Vindhya and the forests surrounding the southern side.

40010880.author: पदार्थः
40010880.content: सीतादर्शनकाङ्क्षिण: eager to see Sita, हरिवराः best of monkeys, ते वानराः those monkeys, शारदाभ्रप्रतिमम् resembling the autumn clouds, श्रीमत् rich, शृङ्गवन्तम् endowed with peaks, दरीमन्तम् with caverns, रजतपर्वतम् silver mountain, अधिरुह्य having ascended, तत्र there, रम्यम् enchanting, लोध्रवनम् Lodhra grove, सप्तपर्णवनानि च and gardens of seven leaves, व्यचिन्वंस्ते they looked out.

40010880.author: Translation
40010880.content: Eager to find Sita, the best of monkeys climbed the silver mountain rich with peaks and caverns resembling the autumnal clouds. And looked out into the Lodhra grove and the garden of seven leaves (banara plantations).

40010881.author: पदार्थः
40010881.content: सीतादर्शनकाङ्क्षिण: eager to see Sita, हरिवराः best of monkeys, ते वानराः those monkeys, शारदाभ्रप्रतिमम् resembling the autumn clouds, श्रीमत् rich, शृङ्गवन्तम् endowed with peaks, दरीमन्तम् with caverns, रजतपर्वतम् silver mountain, अधिरुह्य having ascended, तत्र there, रम्यम् enchanting, लोध्रवनम् Lodhra grove, सप्तपर्णवनानि च and gardens of seven leaves, व्यचिन्वंस्ते they looked out.

40010881.author: Translation
40010881.content: Eager to find Sita, the best of monkeys climbed the silver mountain rich with peaks and caverns resembling the autumnal clouds. And looked out into the Lodhra grove and the garden of seven leaves (banara plantations).

40010882.author: पदार्थः
40010882.content: तस्य its, अग्रम् peak, अधिरूढाः they climbed, विपुलविक्रमाः very brave ones, ते they, श्रान्ताः   exhausted, रामस्य Rama's, प्रियां महिषीम् dear queen, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, न पश्यन्ति स्म  did not find.

40010882.author: Translation
40010882.content: Even after scaling up the peak, the exhausted, heroic monkeys could not find Vaidehi, the dear queen of Rama.

40010883.author: पदार्थः
40010883.content: ते हरयः those monkeys, दृष्टिगतम् having seen all over, बहुकन्दरम् having many caves, तं शैलम् that mountain, कृत्वा after doing so, समन्ततः everywhere, वीक्षमाणाः while looking at, अवारोहन्त descended.

40010883.author: Translation
40010883.content: Having looked all over the mountain and many caverns, those monkeys got down from the mountain.

40010884.author: पदार्थः
40010884.content: ततः then, भूमिम् ground, अवरुह्य descending down, श्रान्ताः tired, विगतचेतसः dejected at heart, तत्र there, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, स्थित्वा having stood, अथ and then, वृक्षमूलम् under a tree, उपाश्रिताः lay down.

40010884.author: Translation
40010884.content: Descending to the foothills, the exhausted monkeys became quiet. Fatigued and disheartened, they assembled under a tree, stood for a moment and then lay down.

40010885.author: पदार्थः
40010885.content: ते they, मुहूर्तम् for a while, समाश्वस्ताः took rest, किञ्चित् a little, भग्नपरिश्रमाः frustrated, पुनरेव once again, कृत्स्नाम् entire, दक्षिणां दिशम् southern side, मार्गितुम् to search, उद्यताः decided.

40010885.author: Translation
40010885.content: Resting for a while, the frustrated monkeys resumed their search throughout the southern direction.

40010886.author: पदार्थः
40010886.content: हनुमत्प्रमुखाः Hanuman being the prominent one of the group, प्लवगर्षभाः bulls among the vanaras, प्रस्थिताः started search, आदितः from the beginning, तावत् all over, विन्ध्यमेव  Vindhya range itself, समन्ततः everywhere, विचेरुः roamed.

40010886.author: Translation
40010886.content: The bulls among vanaras and Hanuman, the chief of the group again started exploring  everywhere in the Vindhya range starting from the beginning. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyninth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
